name: nadir-route
description: Right-size every prompt and every subagent spawn. A UserPromptSubmit hook asks Nadir's free decision API which tier the prompt needs and, when a cheaper tier suffices, has the agent delegate that work to a subagent on it; a PreToolUse hook right-sizes every spawn the same way, using your harness's own aliases so the pick stays in your model family and generation. Complex work and your main thread's own model are never touched, except read-only Explore searches, which take the rung below (Sonnet under an Opus session). Fail-open: any error and the prompt or spawn proceeds exactly as intended.
